ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Start-Process PassThru
ruleDefinitions.description: Powershell use PassThru option to start in background Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Start\\-Process.*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-PassThru\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-FilePath\\ .*"))
